releases.body:
### Changed
- OpenCode 2 now auto-approves any otherwise-asking permission inside Raven Search and Raven MCP, including skill loading, instead of maintaining a tool allowlist. Explicit denials, edit and nested-delegation restrictions, and other agents' permissions remain unchanged.
- Documented that Raven's unattended execution is trusted rather than read-only: shell commands and MCP tools can modify the system or external services.

### Fixed
- Raven Search and MCP follow-ups now validate against the calling session's project instead of the plugin's loading project, avoiding incorrect ownership rejections in OpenCode 2 while preserving parent-session and agent checks.

### Fixed
- V2 Raven agents auto-approve webfetch, websearch, fetch, and enabled global MCP tools at permission evaluation time, without blanket agent permissions. Main-agent permissions and explicit denials remain unchanged.
- Blocked web search, URL fetching, and recognized global MCP calls now recommend `raven_mcp`; local search calls still recommend `raven_seek`. Routing availability and provider recovery use the selected agent.

### Changed
- Raven MCP now has the same retrieval tools as Raven Search, including local file access, shell, and built-in web tools, plus its private on-demand MCP bridge. Edit tools and nested delegation remain denied. V2 web/global MCP execution approvals apply to both Raven agents.
- Delegation instructions distinguish lightweight local retrieval through `raven_seek` from online research through `raven_mcp`, even when no MCP is configured.

### Added
- V2 `raven_seek` and `raven_mcp` now run background child retrievals by default, with `background: false` for foreground waits.
- Compact completion/failure messages return to the actual calling session through V2's synthetic inbox. Undelivered results survive plugin reloads; unfinished retrievals report interruption instead of replaying MCP calls.
- Background lifecycle coverage for continuation locking, cancellation, session deletion, restart recovery, and delivery failures, plus an offline native V2 background smoke check.

### Fixed
- Automatic MCP refresh now runs once per workspace per TUI launch, rather than repeating on plugin reactivation or returning from sessions. Manual refresh remains available.

### Fixed
- V2 manual MCP refreshes now use notifications only, and reopening the TUI shows refresh progress and results in top-right notifications.
- V2 now refreshes on-demand MCP health and tool discovery whenever the TUI attaches to the background service, sharing overlapping checks instead of relying on one-time server initialization.
- V2 MCP-agent requests now receive live capability guidance so refreshed tools are visible without reloading the agent or service.
- V2 `/raven` output now uses an opaque, terminal-height-bounded dialog with keyboard and mouse scrolling instead of an overflowing alert.
- V2 public Raven delegation no longer asks for confirmation on every call. Deny rules and permissions for other tools remain unchanged.
